description: Produce resource-use records from observed or explicitly executed process models while keeping resource execution, discovery and monetary valuation independently owned.
external_dependencies: edithatogo/rust4pm: pin and qualify actual XES/OCEL/PNML support and licence terms.
edithatogo/kairos: Track 114 or its successor must supply a qualified neutral resource-execution contract.
edithatogo/careops-sim: healthcare process models remain provider-owned.
OMG BPMN/PNML and optional PM4Py: supported semantics and licence obligations must be assessed for the selected adapter.

verification.scope: Date-level event, process-instance and object context is implemented. Importers, interval/timestamp derivation, process execution and actual Kairos adapter remain pending.

completion_evidence: Infant/specimen/assay/batch object relationships survive observed-event import without forcing one flat independent case per event.
Each advertised Petri/BPMN construct has explicit timing, marking/branching and resource semantics; unsupported elements fail visibly.
Transfers, occupancy and consumption remain distinguishable; shared staff or batch use is not charged multiple times by trace duplication.
Changing only a quotation release leaves process execution and resource-use identities unchanged.
Kairos remains independent of Dapane; app-level feedback is explicit when prices affect behaviour.
Selected dependency versions/licences and supported subsets are recorded; an imported diagram is not advertised as a general BPMN simulator.
